name: Bloodpetal Zapper
summary: The Bloodpetal Zapper is meant to work against nearby pests. You are told to use it when you see them.

sections.title: A Working Zapper
sections.body: The zapper is ready for you to use. Its giver says it should work perfectly, and asks you to zap any pests you see.

faq.answer: The Bloodpetal Zapper is a device meant to zap pests.

faq.q: When should I use the zapper?
faq.answer: Use the zapper when you see any of the pests.
Its giver says the zapper should work perfectly.
